title: 642. Construct String from Binary Tree

examples.explanation: Node 1 has left subtree 2 (which itself has left child 4) and right child 3, so the parenthesized preorder form is 1(2(4))(3).
Node 2 has no left child but has right child 4, so an empty pair marks the missing left side to keep the mapping unambiguous.
A lone node needs no parentheses.
